---
title: "Tidyverse Cheatsheets"
---

Posit (the organization behind tidyverse and RStudio) maintains cheatsheets for their packages that are good as a quick reference. Each cheatsheet has an html and an image version.

- [RStudio IDE](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/rstudio-ide.html)
- [Data import: readr, readxl, googlesheets4](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/data-import.html)
- [Data transformation with dplyr](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/data-transformation.html)
- [Data tidying with tidyr](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/tidyr.html)
- [Factors with forcats](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/factors.html)
- [Dates and times with lubridate](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/lubridate.html)
- [String manipulation with stringr](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/strings.html)
- [Data visualization with ggplot2](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/data-visualization.html)
- [Functional programming with purrr](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/purrr.html)
- [Reproducible documents using Quarto](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/quarto.html)
